directive.thread_id: film repository port 2026-11-05, lane film-tools, sub-lane checks: the rendered-video checker's helper scripts
directive.quote: Finish the port of the film repository so it can be retired: move each job to its correct home, porting the correct parts one to one and never rebuilding from scratch what already worked; settings are rows in the person's lists, read through the door.

targets.baseline_commit_message: check-a-rendered-video: the film checker-owner's inspect and span-export scripts, moved byte for byte

preserve: the lower eye's openness of the largest face of each picture, sorted, with the mouth openness
the lowest rows, the median and the 10th percentile
the old printout, on standard error
allowed_deltas: the landmarks file is an argument and --lowest sets how many rows the answer lists
no face at all prints no median instead of failing
the last line is {"result": ...} with every value (what eye_table2.py printed)
banned_substitutions: a person's limits file path, film folder or name written in code
a second implementation of a check's numbers beside the check module itself
_paths: A source in the private film repository is named by the BLAKE3 identity of its path (path_multihash); a checkout of that repository beside this one finds it.
